title: Implement FT-001 ActorContext and role policy
verify: ActorContext resolves request_id, session, account, Farm, membership, role, auth provenance, and PlantPermissionContext interface envelope before business logic.
Role preset policy matches Boss, Engineer, and Consultant authority from FT-001.
Consultant cannot operate, create domain task/recommendation records, approve governance by default, or approve physical actions.

PlantPermissionContext includes plant_id, plant_status, can_read, can_comment, can_operate, can_create_domain_tasks, can_manage_access, can_approve_actions, source, and optional grant_id, and remains compatible with the canonical resolver contract.

FT-001 implements the canonical active/archived permission effect through fail-closed resolver adapters or test fixtures, but does not implement PlantAccessGrant persistence/mutations, archive/restore mutations, or retained-history workflows.
T3 closure includes /verify PASS, /red-verify semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, and explicit owner closure; /mb-sync runs at the wave boundary.
evidence_required: PlantPermissionContext shape compatibility evidence against the canonical bounded FT-002 dependency slice

ownership evidence showing FT-001 implements only the bounded Plant status permission effect and does not implement PlantAccessGrant persistence/mutations, archive/restore mutations, or retained-history workflows
constraints: Every protected route/context-builder path must require ActorContext before business logic.
The only MVP per-Plant permission override is plant_approve_actions.
The ActorContext contract defines the PlantPermissionContext interface and bounded resolver semantics; Plant persistence/mutations and the concrete Plant HTTP catalog remain outside this task.
Generic protected-route/context-builder denial may use AUTH_PLANT_FORBIDDEN; do not invent the deferred FT-002 HTTP error catalog.
Do not add a general ACL engine or permission override matrix.
Implement the bounded active/archived permission effect, but do not implement FT-002 PlantAccessGrant persistence, mutation routes, archive/restore mutations, or retained-history workflows.

Preserve verified FT-000 app factory, settings, database/session, migration, readiness, runtime-root, and redaction anchors per Foundation Runtime Substrate, Foundation Data Substrate, and Evidence Redaction specs; stop if implementation contradicts the brownfield baseline.
invariants: Frontend hide/show is presentation only and never an authorization substitute.
Consultant remains advisory/read/comment only by default.
can_approve_actions is actor authority only and never Safety Gate clearance.
verification_targets: Check changed code preserves linked Foundation Runtime Substrate, Foundation Data Substrate, Foundation Smoke API when relevant, and Evidence Redaction contracts or records a blocker.

Check ActorContext and PlantPermissionContext expose the canonical interface envelope fields from the bounded FT-002 dependency slice, including plant_status, grant_id, source=denied, can_comment, and can_create_domain_tasks.

Check ActorContext and PlantPermissionContext implement the bounded active/archived permission effect while remaining interface-only for FT-002 PlantAccessGrant persistence, archive/restore mutations, and retained-history workflows, and fail closed for missing grants.
purpose: Create the ActorContext and role/Plant permission boundary that later Farm/Plant routes and context builders must consume.
success_outcome: Protected backend paths can require a typed ActorContext and derive role/Plant permission decisions without duplicating FT-002 access rules.

forbidden_scope: FT-002 PlantAccessGrant persistence or mutation routes
stop_conditions: ActorContext shape conflicts with the canonical ActorContext contract.
PlantPermissionContext shape conflicts with the bounded FT-002 dependency slice.
Permission resolver implementation requires unresolved FT-002 persistence, retained-history, or archived-Plant lifecycle decisions.
Consultant or missing-grant behavior cannot be proven fail-closed.
Implementation contradicts verified FT-000 app/settings/database/session/redaction baseline.
